briefing: Markets were mildly negative today (NASDAQ -0.3%, S&P 500 -0.6%), but a handful of screened names still show complete bullish confirmation (RSI, MACD, price vs SMA-20, and volume surge all aligned). With cash above the $500 threshold and 3 open slots, I made two measured medium-conviction buys in ERO and LGN rather than staying fully idle, while holding the rest of the portfolio unchanged.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Relative strength is when a stock keeps rising or holds steady even while the overall market is flat or falling, which can signal that investors have particular confidence in that specific company. Today several screened stocks showed full bullish technical confirmation despite the S&P 500 and NASDAQ both dipping slightly.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「相對強度」是指個股在大市持平或下跌時仍然造好或企穩,反映投資者對該公司特別有信心。今日儘管標普500及納斯達克指數同告輕微下跌,部分篩選股份卻同時出現完整的技術面看漲訊號。

market_education.summary_en: Broader indices drifted slightly lower today, with the S&P 500 down 0.6% and the NASDAQ down 0.3%, reflecting a generally cautious, low-conviction session rather than any major shock. A few individual names bucked the trend, showing strong technical confirmation (rising momentum, price above short-term averages, and heavier-than-usual trading volume), which suggests stock-specific buying interest even as the overall market cooled. No major single catalyst news was identified driving today's moves.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤稍為回落,標普500指數下跌0.6%,納斯達克指數下跌0.3%,反映市場氣氛審慎,並非受單一重大事件衝擊。不過部份個股逆勢造好,同時出現多個技術指標轉強訊號(動能上升、股價高於短期均線,以及成交量明顯放大),顯示資金正選擇性流入個別強勢股,而非全面看好大市。今日未有發現明顯的單一新聞催化因素。

trades.reasoning: Full four-signal confirmation (bullish RSI, MACD crossover, price above SMA-20, volume surge) shows real strength even as the broader market is soft.
Same full four-signal confirmation as ERO with a volume surge, offering diversification into a different name at the same top score.
